notes: Observation-horizon extension only; 2023-2024 selection, 2025 onward retrospective evaluation, plus monthly and annual slices.
Calendar month and year use actual Beijing entry time; unresolved/cross-cut trades explicitly retained.
The existing 638-symbol archive is not a point-in-time universe; preserve symbol coverage and fixed-incumbent sensitivity.
Existing frozen exchangeInfo tick sizes are reused; historical tick changes are not reconstructed.
No chart hint rendering or strategy-time gate adoption. Reports are not requested.
Replay starts flat at the available archive boundary; all policies warm their own serial history before analysis_start. The first incomplete/early-history month is separately tested for sensitivity.

warnings: Calendar performance is assigned by actual Beijing entry time; calendar controls are restricted to the same month/year and clock bucket.
Monthly/yearly net outcomes include later exits; period_end_known_closed separately counts outcomes closed before that entry period ended.
The final partial calendar period is marked incomplete and may be right-censored.
Historical clock winners are fixed candidates; no winner is validated or promoted by this summary.
Earlier-selected/later-displayed results are retrospective time cohorts, not an untouched validation set.
Source availability counts use first/last span metadata and do not assert continuous ready bars or a point-in-time universe.
